output.one_liner: Excalidraw is a collaborative virtual whiteboard for teams to sketch, diagram, and brainstorm ideas in real time.
output.description: Excalidraw is an open-source virtual whiteboard tool that mimics the feel of paper sketches with a hand-drawn aesthetic. It supports real-time collaboration, making it ideal for remote teams designing diagrams, wireframes, and visual notes.
output.target_user: Product managers, UX designers, and engineering teams

icp.who: Remote or hybrid technical teams needing visual collaboration
icp.pain: Difficulty communicating complex ideas through text or formal tools
icp.buying_trigger: Onboarding new team members remotely or starting a new product design cycle

Fully client-side operation ensures privacy and offline use
Open-source with self-hosting options for enterprise control
Lightweight and fast with no login required to start
